identity.epoch_admission: Parent owns fresh epoch and same begin context; bridge verifies every source and destination identity

storage.representation: Typed monotonic counters retain finite committed-event debt; no repeated per-event epoch/tag storage

ports.capture: one actual SRAM packedrow commit per stream edge; E II1, BF II2
ports.receipt: one protected destination-visible packedrow receipt per stream edge
ports.phase_event: at most one committed event per stream edge; emitted only when actual phase ready/kind/row agree

ordering.E: Each source commit and destination receipt yields one event, in row order
ordering.BF: Each actual packedrow commit or receipt yields lower-half event then upper-half event
reject: BF capture before all E destination receipts
event consumption against wrong phase row

latency.bound: Clock edges with phase continuously ready at matching row; arbitrary phase backpressure adds measured waiting, never discarded events

scope: No payload recomputation; actual source/destination commits from qualified payload component
